audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven chart rows disagreed with the whys printed directly beneath them. The rows read Skill / Warwick / Warwick / Skill / Skill / Warwick / Warwick, while the whys said Level 1 is yours, Levels 2-3 are even, Level 6 favours you, and the first-item and two-item stages belong to Wukong. The packet chart agrees with the whys, not the rows.
audit.why: Warwick's Q heal-for-damage-dealt wins level 1 before Wukong's kit is online; levels 2-5 are a decoy-reading skill lane; level 6 is Warwick's when Warrior Trickster and Cyclone are both down; after Wukong's first item his armour shred and burst take over.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6 proposed as matched full/content pairs to Warwick / Skill / Skill / Warwick / Wukong / Wukong, with row 3 already Skill and ratings moved to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why and phases[6].why sold Warwick's Blade of the Ruined King timing and two-item side lane as winning stages, on the two rows the chart gives to Wukong.
audit.why: Wukong's armour-shred and burst item lands before Warwick's sustain item matters, and in teamfights Cyclone's displacement plus the clone escape mean Warwick's two-item value is a flank onto a carry, not a side-lane duel.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why re-keyed to fighting only after Nimbus Strike is spent; phases[6].why re-keyed to Cyclone and the flank plan.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every Warwick-side number was absent: the do's and don'ts said 'R after it' and 'with E down' without ever stating what R or E actually do or cost.
audit.why: Infinite Duress is a channelled leap that suppresses for 1.5 seconds on 110/90/70, so it is spent after his engage, never into it — and a displacement on Warwick cuts the channel, which is exactly what Cyclone threatens. Primal Howl gives 2.5 seconds of damage reduction on 15/14/13/12/11 and fears for 1 second at the end or on recast, so it is both the burst-eater and the way to shed the real body once the decoy has been read.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d now carries R's 110s rank-1 cost and the after-his-engage rule; dosFull[1].d states Primal Howl's 2.5s damage reduction across the decoy; tradeBad and dontsFull[2].d state the same with the 15s cooldown instead of the word 'fear'.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Nimbus Strike's cooldown.
edits.after: His armour shred and burst item land before yours; fight only in the window after Nimbus Strike is spent.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Wukong carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Cyclone displaces your whole line and the clone eats your follow-up — carry threat 7/10, so flank for a carry, not a duel.

edits.before: His engage dash. R after it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His engage dash. Your R is 110s at rank 1 — spend it after his.

edits.before: Q-bite Wukong as he steps up (hold Q to follow his dash), weave autos, and let the passive out-heal his return damage.
edits.after: Hold Primal Howl through the decoy: 2.5s of damage reduction covers his burst, then the howl fears the real body off you.

edits.before: Trading into his full burst window with E down — fear is your trade-flipper; without it you are just a sustain bot.
edits.after: Fighting with Primal Howl down — its 2.5s of damage reduction is the only thing that survives his burst, and it is 15s.

edits.after: Fighting with Primal Howl down — its 2.5s of damage reduction is the only thing that survives his burst, and it is 15s.

notes: The brief's enemyKit was null for Wukong, so I could not verify a single Wukong cooldown, range or flag from Riot's data. Every edit here is therefore either a chart alignment (packet + the page's own whys), or built strictly from Warwick's kit. I deliberately did not add or restate Wukong ability numbers, and I left the existing claims about Crushing Blow's armour shred, the Warrior Trickster clone and Cyclone's displacement untouched rather than re-asserting them. No mirror audit existed for this matchup.
